history.note: Player names are typed in by players and aren't moderated. If a name breaks the rules or contains your personal data, ask for it to be removed via GitHub Issues.

s1.title: Start a room
s1.body: Click Create room, sign your name and choose how many ships of each size you both get. You'll get a code. Your friend picks Join, enters their name and that code.

s2.title: Place your ships
s2.body: Drag a ship from the shipyard onto your grid. Press <k>R</k> or right‑click to rotate (on a phone: touch with a second finger while dragging). Drag a placed ship to move it, <k>Delete</k> or the remove button takes it off. Ships can't touch each other, not even at the corners.

s3.title: Take your shot
s3.body: The title at the top says whose turn it is. When it reads <h>Your turn</h>, click any empty square on your opponent's grid to fire. A hit lets you shoot again, a miss passes the turn.

s4.title: Mark your guesses
s4.body: Right‑click a square on the opponent's grid (on a touchpad or touchscreen: tap it with two fingers), or turn on Mark mode and click it, to colour it yellow. It's just a note for you, not a shot. Do it again to rub it out.

s5.title: Read the grid
s5.sunk: Sunk, the whole ship is down

s6.title: Win the game
s6.body: Sink every enemy ship first and you win. After the game you can look over both boards and hit Play again for a rematch. If someone's connection drops, the game waits a minute for them to come back.
